key_points: CNQ acquiring Advantage Energy for $1.8B cash, adding Montney/Charlie Lake assets adjacent to Grande Prairie operations
Bolt-on acquisition represents ~1.8% of CNQ's market cap - strategically sensible but not transformative
Cash-funded deal preserves balance sheet strength; likely modestly accretive to free cash flow per share
Other headlines are generic dividend commentary or peer news with no direct CNQ impact
Integration execution and commodity price path remain key drivers over coming quarters
